cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've underlined the first line of this hospital letter like you did. Good news marked out. Read it before I do, would you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I underlined the reference number. Do you want me to read the letter aloud?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, start with the number. Then the words, as long as your face stays fairly ordinary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you. We can take one line at a time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep hold of the page too. I'll follow your finger; you don't need to ask why I'm so slow.
